reference_change.title: perf: eliminate libc memcpy/memset/memmove calls in to_chars hotpath

workload.source: written here from the title of https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/pull/2805 (to_chars in the DOM serializer and the string builder): a C++ program that serializes a parsed array of 100,000 doubles 400 times with simdjson::to_string, eval/tasks/workloads/simdjson-simdjson-pr2805/eval_to_chars.cpp, copied into the tree and built with the system c++ against src/simdjson.cpp; the benchmark the pull request quotes (benchmark_car_builder) is not used

oracle.source: simdjson's own string builder tests (tests/builder/builder_string_builder_tests.cpp, which appends doubles through the changed to_chars), compiled directly against src/simdjson.cpp as a single executable instead of through CMake

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: timings: 0.84 ns; 0.85 ns; 0.81 ns

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Needs a C++20 compiler named c++ on the PATH (tested with Apple clang 17.0.0 on arm64 macOS)
